preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
native_verification: tests/native_verifier.py: actual exit, registered test completion, raw ordered logs, unchanged snapshots, identical binary repeated three times.

renode_schema_selection.contract: Resolve the actual selected west Studio project in parent and isolated workspaces; refuse failed, ambiguous, relative or incomplete selections; retain independent calls and recovery without a stale recursive fallback.
renode_schema_selection.entry: Included in tests/test_owner.py; the complete Renode wired-split smoke and owner RPC suite remain separate.
renode_schema_selection.regression: The original fixture passed all generic smoke checks but ran zero module cases because it searched only beneath the module root in a parent workspace. Identical-binary before runs retain that setup failure.

regression_fixtures.contract: Secure keyspace namespaces require unlock for scoped mutations even when empty; array size loads retain immutable identity; scope operations include empty arrays and reset removes inactive persisted slots.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Original-source runs fail the permission, load-size and empty-array checks; independent scalar permissions and unchanged load-view/mutation controls pass.
regression_fixtures.limits: Real kernel/settings and native RPC codec/dispatch, controlled backend; no physical transport, storage retention or power-loss claim.

regression_fixtures.contract: Quiet scalar, small/large raw, typed/raw keyspace and save retain exact registry values and synchronous core events; real Studio queue submissions are zero for quiet and exactly one for ordinary; independent nested writer still notifies; existing observed suppression snapshot count preserved.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: tests/quiet_notify_negative_control.py removes only the Studio quiet-event guard in a separate owner copy; unchanged owner native fixture must fail.
regression_fixtures.limits: Queue submission selection only; legacy global suppression and physical transport congestion/delivery remain separate gaps.

regression_fixtures.contract: The real settings load path refuses empty/non-decimal, out-of-capacity and overflowing stored decimal ordinals before reading payloads; invalid first/later records preserve independent settings and valid slot identities/keys/payloads/dirty state, while valid leading-zero ordinals still load.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: tests/ordinal_overflow_negative_control.py restores only unchecked multiply/add in an isolated source copy; unchanged real-loader assertions must fail on #4294967296 aliasing slot zero.
regression_fixtures.limits: Controlled Zephyr settings backend and uint32/capacity boundaries; physical NVS corruption, power loss and retention are not established.

regression_fixtures.contract: Small/large rename validation and allocation refusals preserve the entry; PERSIST backend pre-write refusal retains the new RAM key as dirty and previous durable key without a changed event. Same-slot payloads, independent entries/scalars, save retry and discard/reload recovery are exact.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Before contract correction the same real-loader/backend fixture records -EIO with RAM=item/new, dirty=1, durable=item/old and events=0, disproving the previous unconditional unchanged-on-failure promise. No production rename behavior changed.
regression_fixtures.limits: Existing RAM-first semantics under a controlled backend; no transaction/rollback guarantee, concurrent keyspace lifecycle or physical NVS/power-loss claim. Old durable key retention is proven only for the controlled pre-write refusal; arbitrary physical errors have no atomic durability guarantee.

regression_fixtures.contract: The real settings load path refuses uint32 decimal overflow and incomplete bounded names before payload reads; valid element values/length/dirty state and independent settings stay exact, including first/last indices and leading zeros.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: tests/array_ordinal_negative_control.py removes checked accumulation or full termination separately in isolated src copies; unchanged owner loader assertions must fail three times per fault.
regression_fixtures.limits: Controlled Zephyr settings backend and configured name/uint32/capacity bounds, not physical NVS corruption or retention.

regression_fixtures.contract: Compound array/keyspace operations serialize selection and mutation; invalid structural modes leave state unchanged; shifted values are dirty while persistent record flags remain ordinal.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Fifteen original-code failures with one passing serial control, same binary repeated three times per scenario.
regression_fixtures.limits: Controlled scheduling/backend and actual Zephyr mutex/thread/event logic; no physical durability or transport claim.

regression_fixtures.negative_control: The original handler normalizes unknown modes to MEMORY.
regression_fixtures.limits: Actual codec/dispatch and unchanged state; no physical transport claim.

regression_fixtures.contract: Retire old session replies/subscriptions/timers and prevent later import/chunk calls after connection/index/catalog replacement; bound list collection.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Original App fails the provider/deferred regression cases while unrelated-provider and StrictMode controls pass.
regression_fixtures.limits: Controlled DOM and mocked transport boundary; already-sent requests cannot be recalled.

regression_fixtures.contract: Resolve loaded array records from immutable descriptor/index after a backend wait; stale chunk transfers cannot modify a deleted/reused keyspace slot. Guard staging, target identity and commit together.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Original loader is redirected by a real sysworkq view-pool churn; original chunk handler commits to a reused slot. Regression output is retained separately from positive owner results.
regression_fixtures.limits: Synthetic backend/scheduling and actual registry/handler logic, not physical durability or USB/BLE delivery.

regression_fixtures.fixture: tests/support/behavior_load_cases.inc in the checked local-ID core init
regression_fixtures.contract: Load range-valid persisted behavior values and behavior-ID constraints without requiring the later settings-table lookup. Runtime writes still reject unresolved IDs and invalid binding parameters; independent records and the initialized event count remain exact.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: The same real settings-backend fixture fails before the load-validation fix because unresolved stored IDs are discarded. Existing behavior validation and event snapshots are retained.
regression_fixtures.limits: Pinned DYA settings-table configuration and synthetic backend records; not physical reboot retention or a test of pending upstream storage redesigns.

regression_fixtures.contract: Retain array-element view identity and temporary state through synchronous out-of-lock event dispatch; format persistence names without recycling the caller view; fail a new-view push before mutation when the bounded pool is fully retained, then recover after release.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: The unchanged real-kernel unlock handoff redirects the original notification to a different array three times, with a passing serial control. An isolated retain-guard fault must reproduce the event-identity failure. tests/notification_view_negative_control.py removes only the pool recycling guard in an isolated source copy.
regression_fixtures.limits: Seven controlled kernel/backend scenarios and exact event/value checks; no physical transport, retention, timing or indefinite borrowed-handle guarantee.

regression_fixtures.contract: Locked, stale queued and lock-unlock-retired peripheral notifications and delayed lists cannot reach local Studio; unchanged unlocked sessions still deliver.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Original handler with the unchanged security fixture fails its checked init; repeat the same binary three times from fresh state.
regression_fixtures.limits: Actual lock API, events, kernel work and nanopb relay codec; controlled notification dispatch, not physical transport cancellation.

regression_fixtures.contract: Queue copied subsystem/key/array index, resolve and retain only while encoding; a deliberate full retained-view churn proves the borrowed target was reused before draining the queue.
regression_fixtures.negative_control: Restoring a borrowed queue pointer must fail the same deferred-identity case; serial delivery remains a control.
regression_fixtures.limits: Native view-pool reuse and actual notification worker; no indefinite borrowed-handle or transport-delivery guarantee.
